forbidden.name: dependency-cruiser/layer-order:features
forbidden.comment: The layer features (src/features) must not import from the layers above it: app

forbidden.name: dependency-cruiser/layer-order:domain
forbidden.comment: The layer domain (src/domain) must not import from the layers above it: app, features

forbidden.name: dependency-cruiser/closed-modules:src/features/*
forbidden.comment: Code outside src/features/* imports only its public files: index.ts

forbidden.name: dependency-cruiser/closed-modules:src/features/*:from-another-module
forbidden.comment: Code in one module of src/features/* imports only the public files of another: index.ts

forbidden.name: dependency-cruiser/no-circular
forbidden.comment: Modules must not import each other in a cycle

forbidden.name: dependency-cruiser/no-ui-in-pure-layer
forbidden.comment: The layers of pure computation (domain) must not import UI libraries: react, react-dom, react-native, preact, vue, svelte, solid-js, @angular/core
